name: Stoddard Buttress
approach: Same as the North Buttress: Goodell Creek trailhead to the high camp in Crescent Creek Basin (~6,000 ft gain, ~7-7.5 hrs), then on the climbing day cross the Ottohorn-Himmelhorn col and descend the Mustard Glacier to the base of the north face (2-3 hrs from camp). Stoddard's original approach used a two-day approach via Stettattle Ridge and the upper McMillan Creek cirque.
